title: Biosecurity program; establishment.
bodyText:
[PART VI.] BIOSECURITY PROGRAM

The department shall establish a biosecurity program authorized under this chapter that shall interface with other relevant state law; provided that the biosecurity program is not inconsistent with federal law. The department shall act as the lead agency for the State's biosecurity efforts.
